sqlMap.select: SELECT '1000' AS BUKRS , APRV_NO AS ZISSID , (SELECT MAX(ISSUE_DATE) FROM KEPTARDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = A.TAX_BILL_NO) AS ZMKDT , NULL AS ZISSNO , 'KRW' AS HWAER , TO_CHAR(MAX(TOT_SUPP_PRICE) * DECODE(TAX_BILL_TYPE,'D',-1,1)) AS HWBAS , TO_CHAR(MAX(TOT_TAX_PRICE) * DECODE(TAX_BILL_TYPE,'D',-1,1)) AS HWSTE , TO_CHAR(MAX(TOT_AMT) * DECODE(TAX_BILL_TYPE,'D',-1,1)) AS ZTTAT , ORIGIN_APRV_NO AS ZORG_ID , TAX_BILL_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_AR_SEND A WHERE BUYER = 'KRAEKY0006' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY APRV_NO,ORIGIN_APRV_NO,TAX_BILL_TYPE,TAX_BILL_NO

SELECT BUKRS , ZISSID , NULL AS ZISSNO , TO_CHAR(RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY ZISSID ORDER BY ZISSID,BUDGET_DEPT,ACCOUNT_TYPE)) AS ZISSLN , (SELECT MAX(ISSUE_DATE) FROM KEPTARDT WHERE TAX_BILL_NO = X.TAX_BILL_NO) AS ZMKDT , BUDGET_DEPT AS KOSTL , ACCOUNT_TYPE AS HKONT , ITEM_AMT AS HWBAS , TAX_AMT AS HWSTE , T_AMT AS ZTTAT , TAX_BILL_NO FROM (SELECT '1000' AS BUKRS , APRV_NO AS ZISSID , KEY_1 AS BUDGET_DEPT , KEY_2 AS ACCOUNT_TYPE , TO_CHAR(SUM(GR_AMT) * DECODE(TAX_BILL_TYPE,'D',-1,1)) ITEM_AMT , TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SUM(GR_AMT)/10,0) * DECODE(TAX_BILL_TYPE,'D',-1,1)) TAX_AMT , TO_CHAR((SUM(GR_AMT) + TRUNC(SUM(GR_AMT)/10,0)) * DECODE(TAX_BILL_TYPE,'D',-1,1)) AS T_AMT , TAX_BILL_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_AR_SEND A WHERE BUYER = 'KRAEKY0006' AND APRV_NO = #ZISSID# AND IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY APRV_NO,KEY_1,KEY_2 ,TAX_BILL_TYPE, TAX_BILL_NO ) X
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_AR_SEND SET IF_DATE = #IF_DATE# , IF_TIME = #IF_TIME# , IF_FLAG = #TYPE# WHERE BUYER = 'KRAEKY0006' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND APRV_NO = #ZISSID#
